description.default: Auto-number figures, tables and equations, then refresh cross-references automatically about 1.5s after you stop typing. Captions are centered with a faint tint. Equation blocks are updated in place on data-content only, so formulas are never wiped; empty equations are skipped and the run is paused while a formula or code editor is focused and retried automatically right after. Dead references become red struck-through text. Slash command /xref inserts a live block reference; custom hotkeys supported.
description.zh-CN: 自动重排图、表、公式编号并同步刷新交叉引用；写完题注停手约 1.5 秒自动生效。图/表题注自动居中并加一层浅底色（深浅可调）。公式只改 data-content 上的编号，不重建块，公式正文绝不会丢；空公式不编号。正在输入公式或代码时整轮跳过并自动补一轮重试，不会一次被打断就再也不排。指向已删块的失效引用会转成红色删除线文本。编辑器内输入 /xref 插入引用。支持自定义快捷键（默认 Ctrl+Alt+R 插入引用、Ctrl+Alt+N 重排编号），设置面板里按键即可录制。长文档不再受 SQL 64 行上限影响，采集只走 2 次请求。
